en.description:
Ultimate Games for Apple Watch
Turn your Apple Watch into a pocket-sized arcade!
Enjoy a growing collection of fun and easy mini-games made for quick breaks, waiting lines, or just relaxing moments during your day.

Enjoy a growing collection of fun and easy mini-games made just for Apple Watch.
Challenge yourself, beat your own scores, and have quick bursts of fun wherever you are.

Highlights include:

Tic Tac Toe

Pong

Tricky Circle

Whack A Bug

Space Defender

Ground Defense

Pass the Ball

Fast Match

Match’em

Sliding Blocks

Watch & Repeat

…and many more!

Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term. Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service. 
— Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
— Terms of Use (EULA) https://argames.in/terms.html
— Privacy Policy: https://argames.in/privacy.html
en.releaseNotes:
Became a captain of a warship! Command it in an intense naval battle and lead it the a win
- Dodge enemies that try to ram you
- Shoot powerful enemies with you supreme cannons
- Survive as long as you can and push your reflexes to the limit
en.subtitle: Over 30 games for Apple Watch

New update with two brand new games here!

1. Zuma Spiral - a fast-paced classic with a twist
- Shoot colored balls into a moving spiral
- Match 3+ colors to trigger satisfying chain reactions
- The spiral speeds up as your score grows
- Stop the balls before they reach the center

2. Floor Hopper - test your timing and precision
- Roll across the rising floors and dodge deadly obstacles 
- Jump using the digital crown - small turns for small jumps, big turns for bigger ones
- Teleport to next floor to score a point
- One mistake - game over
